segments.an5.255:1.1: “Pañcannaṃ, bhikkhave, macchariyānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
segments.an5.255:1.4: kulamacchariyassa…pe… lābhamacchariyassa… vaṇṇamacchariyassa… dhammamacchariyassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
segments.an5.255:1.5: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ macchariyānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussatī”ti.
